statement: For every realized finite Juggler word w, n^{3^{#O(w)}} = T_w(n)^{2^{|w|}} + Δ_w(n), where Δ is the recursively lifted accumulation of local floor remainders. Δ ≥ 0, so the power envelope is a corollary; Δ = 0 iff every local remainder vanishes; concatenation is the two-term power-gap lift, not an additive sum.
